projects.title: CloudOps: Automated Cloud Infrastructure & Progressive Delivery
projects.subtitle: 5-Phase Cloud Platform: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Argo Rollouts & Grafana
projects.problemStatement: Modern engineering teams face fragile manual deployments, lack of canary deployment safeguards, high cloud test costs, fragmented observability, and inadequate disaster recovery procedures.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Architected and deployed an end-to-end, cost-conscious cloud platform built across 5 modular phases: (1) Modular AWS VPC & EKS in Terraform with S3 backend locking; (2) Hardened Python microservice with GitHub Actions CI/CD to GHCR; (3) Prometheus, Loki, Promtail, and Grafana-as-code observability; (4) Argo Rollouts canary traffic shifting (25% → 50% → 75% → 100%) on kind; (5) Velero & in-cluster MinIO backup executing 100% state restoration in 17 seconds.
architectureHighlights: Modular Terraform VPC across 2 AZs with encrypted S3 state and native locking (use_lockfile)
Hardened non-root Python microservice with automated GitHub Actions CI/CD to GHCR
Resource-conscious Prometheus metrics scraping and single-binary Loki log streaming
Argo Rollouts automated multi-step Canary traffic shifting with rollback verification
Velero disaster recovery with 100% namespace restoration validated in 17 seconds

projects.title: Enterprise Release Checksum & Operations Automation Engine
projects.subtitle: Parallelized Shell Automation for Oracle BRM Releases at Mobily Infotech
projects.problemStatement: Manual release verification for bi-weekly Oracle BRM releases involved over 100 repetitive CLI steps, creating severe operational friction, consuming over 50 hours of monthly toil, and risking human error on production billing platforms.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Engineered parallelized shell scripts utilizing time-based filtering and asynchronous background jobs to automate checksum operations and artifact integrity validation across distributed environments. Integrated automated logging, status verification, and failure alerting.
architectureHighlights: Parallelized background workers executing simultaneous artifact checksum calculations
Time-based filtering mechanism targeting exact release windows without manual intervention
Eliminated 100+ manual CLI steps per release cycle while eliminating human execution errors
Standardized operational procedure adopted across engineering operations teams

projects.title: Oracle BRM Partitioned Database Telemetry & SQL Performance Suite
projects.subtitle: High-Availability Capacity Management & Incident Diagnosis at Mobily Infotech
projects.problemStatement: High-volume enterprise billing systems process massive transaction volumes where slow database queries, partition skews, or backend exceptions can cause SLA breaches and customer billing disruption.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Authored and optimized analytical Oracle SQL and PL/SQL queries on large partitioned databases to support capacity management, trace application telemetry, identify data anomalies before end-user service degradation, and formulate technical summaries for L2/L3 engineering escalations.
architectureHighlights: Optimized analytical SQL queries on partitioned tables reducing diagnosis query runtime
Proactive capacity monitoring detecting storage and transaction bottlenecks in advance
Integrated Unix command-line utilities for rapid exception and error log correlation
Drafted detailed technical incident summaries that measurably reduced MTTR

projects.title: Hardened Python Microservice & DevSecOps Delivery Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Secure Containerization, Health Probes & GitHub Actions GHCR Workflows
projects.problemStatement: Running containers as root with mutable tags introduces severe security vulnerabilities and deployment instability in orchestration clusters.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Developed a containerized Python microservice implementing non-root security boundaries, explicit `/healthz` liveness and readiness endpoints, and automated GitHub Actions workflows that publish immutable commit-SHA tagged images to GitHub Container Registry (GHCR).
architectureHighlights: Multi-stage Docker builds minimizing final image attack surface and runtime dependencies
Enforced non-root user execution conforming to Kubernetes security best practices
Immutable commit-SHA image tagging preventing tag mutation and drift
Automated GitHub Actions pipeline with build verification and registry publishing
